name: api
description: HTTP service: transport, domain, storage and contracts in separate layers.

layout.role: the entry point and wiring only
transport: routes, handlers, request/response shapes

Rules and types that do not depend on HTTP, storage or the platform. Import only the standard library and this folder.

HTTP handlers translate requests into domain calls. No business rules here.

Wiring only: configuration, adapters and the server lifecycle.
